description: API side of the sheet: pure category-match.ts, pure bulk-sheet.plan.ts (planProductGroup, mergeAttr, toSheetExportRows), BulkSheetService (importRows with per-group matching/ownership/transactions, exportSheet), routes GET /admin/products/sheet and POST /admin/products/bulk-v2 on AdminCatalogueController, removal of GET /admin/products/export + exportRows/toExportRows/ProductExportRow, deprecated JSDoc on POST /admin/products/bulk. Includes design-review round-3 Finding 1 (single-row Size/Colour twin propagation + export fallback) and NITs 3, 5 (server half), 9, 11. Depends on FEAT-001 (Prisma columns) and FEAT-002 (shared module). Design refs: design.md §5, §6 (6a/6b/6c), §7 (export rules; workbook build is FEAT-004), §9, §10, §11 'API specs'; design-review.md findings 1, 3, 5, 9, 11; plan.md 'Finding 1' section.
steps: category-match.ts (new, apps/api/src/modules/catalogue/category-match.ts): normCategoryKey (body identical to bulkUpsert's normKey), matchCategory(input, all) (exact slug any isActive -> lower-cased exact slug -> normKey on slug/name among isActive !== false; ambiguous / unknown + hint messages identical to bulkUpsert), categoryLabels(all). In ProductService.bulkUpsert replace ONLY the local normKey lambda with the imported normCategoryKey. category-match.spec.ts: tea-coffee, 'Tea & Coffee', ambiguous 'Ghee' (same fixture as the bulkUpsert specs) + inactive category matches by exact slug but not by name.

ProductService: make uniqueSlug and findOrCreateBrandByName public (bodies unchanged). Delete exportRows, toExportRows, ProductExportRow and their specs in product.service.spec.ts (the 'toExportRows' and 'ProductService.exportRows' describes, and the toExportRows import). Remove the `@Get('products/export')` route. Add `/** @deprecated use POST /admin/products/bulk-v2 (Excel sheet) */` on the bulk route/bulkUpsert (no behaviour change).

bulk-sheet.plan.ts (new, pure, sync): export mergeAttr(attrs, canonical, matchSet, value | 'remove' | null) per §6b; planProductGroup(group, ctx) -> { plan: ProductPlan | null; issues } implementing every §6b rule (parent fields, brand fallback + numeric warning + case-insensitive same-brand no-op, HSN whitespace compare + 4/6/8 warning only when written, GST list / kept non-standard / blank rules and parentGst/gstForExclusive, images isUrlRef, Colour/Dimensions product attrs, trimmed text compare, variant rows parsing + bounds, effective tax type, child GST rules, Exclusive conversion, sp'>mrp' error, weight/cost warnings, slab steps 1-4, attributes via mergeAttr with numeric Pack Of compare, child image 2-5 warning, reactivate, diff-only data via stableStringify, gallery candidate + no-op rules, 'Product not created — none of its variant rows are valid'). ctx = { product (with images, brand {id,name}|null; null if new), variantsBySku, allCats, parentSkuOf, parentSkuClash, weightUnitHint }.

Finding 1 in planProductGroup, SINGLE-ROW form only (Parent row without children acting as the variant with sku = P). Let pAttrs = copy of product.attributesJson ?? {}, vAttrs = copy of V?.attributesJson ?? {}, sizeSet = {'size'}, colourSet = {'colour','color'}, holds(attrs,set,x) = some key k with k.trim().toLowerCase() in set and String(attrs[k]).trim() === x, has(attrs,set) = some such key exists. SIZE (cell s non-blank, trimmed): unchanged iff holds(vAttrs,sizeSet,s) || (!has(vAttrs,sizeSet) && holds(pAttrs,sizeSet,s)) -> touch nothing. Otherwise vAttrs = mergeAttr(vAttrs,'Size',sizeSet,s) and, if has(pAttrs,sizeSet), pAttrs = mergeAttr(pAttrs,'Size',sizeSet,s). COLOUR (cell c non-blank, trimmed): unchanged iff holds(pAttrs,colourSet,c) || (!has(pAttrs,colourSet) && holds(vAttrs,colourSet,c)) -> touch nothing. Otherwise pAttrs = mergeAttr(pAttrs,'Color',colourSet,c) and, if has(vAttrs,colourSet), vAttrs = mergeAttr(vAttrs,'Color',colourSet,c). Blank cell -> nothing. Child rows keep the plain §6b mapping (size -> variant Size, colour -> variant Color); multi-variant Parent rows keep Colour -> product Color only. Diffs still go through stableStringify, so 'unchanged' produces no write.

NIT 5 (server half): when ctx.weightUnitHint === 'g' and the parsed weight exceeds 50,000 g, it is a ROW ERROR (not the warning): `Weight is in kg — ${raw} looks like grams; enter ${Number(raw)/1000} (e.g. 0.2)` where raw is the trimmed cell text. Otherwise the existing 50 kg warning stays.

toSheetExportRows(product, parentSku, categoryLabel) in bulk-sheet.plan.ts per §7 (single-row form when exactly one active variant and variant.sku === parentSku; Parent+Child form otherwise; zero-variant products = Parent row only; over-limit text blank except Child title truncated to 200; gallery first 5 of de-duplicated, all-or-nothing blank when any URL > 2048; Pack Of export rule; gst `${taxRatePct}%`; taxType 'Inclusive'; tiers via tierPercentsFromSlabs/tier1Percent). Finding 1 export: single-row size = pickAttr(variant,'size') || pickAttr(product,'size'); colour = pickAttr(product,'color','colour') || pickAttr(variant,'color','colour') (case-insensitive lookups; put a small local pickAttr helper in the plan file).

BulkSheetService (new apps/api/src/modules/catalogue/bulk-sheet.service.ts; constructor(prisma: PrismaService, products: ProductService); logger = new Logger('BulkSheetService')): importRows(rows, opts?: { weightUnit?: 'g' | 'kg' }) per §6: groupSheetRows, load allCats once, per group sequentially: §6a match steps by group shape (single-row: 1,2,3,4,5 with the step-3 _count multi-variant guard; with children: 1,2,4, variant-P group error, 5), lazy derived map via assignParentSkus over product.findMany({ select: { id, slug, sku, title, createdAt, variants: { select: { sku, isActive } } }, orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'asc' }, { id: 'asc' }] }) giving parentSkuOf + productOfDerivedSku, ownership check (all 4 rules), case hints (not-found, new product, new variant), loads in order (variantsBySku, target with images+brand, parentSkuClash), planProductGroup, execute §6c. exportSheet() per §7 queries -> { rows, categories } (leaf active categories with labels via categoryLabels, path 'Parent › Child', sorted by path).

NIT 3 in importRows: when the chosen target T has sku null and the plan would save `sku: P` (target found by step 2 or 3), if productOfDerivedSku.get(P) (build the map if not built) is a product other than T, raise a group error on every row: `Parent SKU ${P} is already the Parent SKU of "${L.title}" — use a different Parent SKU.` and write nothing.

§6c execute: brand + slug resolved before the transaction; prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => ..., { timeout: 20_000 }); product create (status 'published', isReturnable true, sku P) / diff update (+ sku when null); variant create + inventory.create + StockMovement when stock > 0 (reason 'adjustment', ref 'bulk-sheet'); variant diff update; stock via fresh inventory.findUnique inside tx, upsert + movement delta only when different. NIT 9: gallery replace keeps alts: `alt: existing.find((i) => i.url === url)?.alt ?? ''` (existing = ctx.product.images). Failure: every row of the group gets `Not saved: <message>`; planner errors kept, plan warnings dropped. NIT 11: P2002 -> branch on err.meta?.target (array or string): includes 'sku' -> 'SKU is already used by another product or variant.'; includes 'slug' -> 'Another product with the same title was saved at the same moment — upload the file again.'; else generic message. logger.warn(`bulk-sheet group ${P} failed: ${code ?? message}`); end-of-request logger.log summary.

Controller + module: in admin-catalogue.controller.ts add sheetRowSchema built from SHEET_FIELD_MAX (`s(SHEET_FIELD_MAX.key)`; row int 2..1_000_000), bulkSheetSchema = z.object({ rows: z.array(sheetRowSchema).min(1).max(1000), weightUnit: z.enum(['g','kg']).optional() }) (NIT 5), class BulkSheetDto; routes `@Get('products/sheet') bulkSheetExport()` placed where products/export was (before products/:id/detail) and `@Post('products/bulk-v2') bulkSheetImport(@Body() dto)` -> importRows(dto.rows, { weightUnit: dto.weightUnit }). Inject BulkSheetService; register it in catalogue.module.ts providers.

Specs: bulk-sheet.plan.spec.ts (pure planner + toSheetExportRows) and bulk-sheet.service.spec.ts with its own in-memory fake Prisma exactly as design.md §11 lists (findUnique by sku/id/slug, findMany shapes, _count shape, insensitive queries, $transaction, write recording, JSON returned with reverse-sorted keys). Cover EVERY case in §11 'API specs' (owner sample AC-3/AC-4, re-import AC-5, Exclusive AC-6, AC-10, AC-11 matching incl. Sesame Oil / OIL-500 / Wildflower Honey scenarios A/B, single-row multi-variant guard, case hints, parentSkuClash, brand, GST variants, HSN, Pack Of, slabs, stock, bounds, reactivate, transaction failure, export cases, full round trip with the listed fixture then a second pass with zero writes). Add round-3 specs: Finding 1 — wizard-shaped single-variant product (product {Size:'M',Color:'Blue'}, variant {Size:'M',Color:'Blue'}, variant sku = product sku) + sheet Size 'L' -> both Size keys 'L'; sheet Colour 'Red' -> both Color keys 'Red'; unchanged re-import -> zero writes; product Size 'Medium' + variant Size 'M' re-import of its export -> zero writes; variant without Size + product Size 'M' re-import -> zero writes. NIT 3 — two legacy products where L's derived key is used as T's Parent SKU (T matched via its child SKU) -> group error, zero writes. NIT 5 — weightUnit 'g' + weight cell '200' -> row error; weightUnit 'g' + '0.2' -> ok; no hint + '200' -> warning only. NIT 9 — changed gallery keeps the alt of a retained URL. NIT 11 — P2002 with meta.target ['slug'] -> the slug message. Controller metadata: Reflect.getMetadata(ROLES_KEY, AdminCatalogueController) contains 'catalogue_manager' and prototype has bulkSheetImport + bulkSheetExport (find ROLES_KEY in apps/api/src/common/auth/roles.decorator).

Commit by explicit path (new: category-match.ts(+spec), bulk-sheet.plan.ts(+spec), bulk-sheet.service.ts(+spec); tracked: admin-catalogue.controller.ts, product.service.ts, product.service.spec.ts; catalogue.module.ts is pre-existing UNTRACKED -> do not stage, list it in the commit body): `feat(catalogue): Excel sheet import/export API (bulk-v2, products/sheet)`.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm --filter @belzo/api test passes, including bulk-sheet.service.spec.ts cases for AC-3, AC-4, AC-5, AC-6, AC-9 (round trip: only product.update({data:{sku}}) for the two null-sku products, then a second pass with zero writes), AC-10, AC-11, AC-12, and the Finding 1 / NIT 3 / 5 / 9 / 11 specs
Existing ProductService.bulkUpsert specs (tea-coffee, Tea & Coffee, ambiguous Ghee) still pass unchanged
GET /admin/products/export, exportRows, toExportRows and ProductExportRow no longer exist (AC-14 API half); both new routes are on AdminCatalogueController
findings: Commit bb4678a on master (local, not pushed). New: apps/api/src/modules/catalogue/{category-match.ts,category-match.spec.ts,bulk-sheet.plan.ts,bulk-sheet.plan.spec.ts,bulk-sheet.service.ts,bulk-sheet.service.spec.ts}; tracked: admin-catalogue.controller.ts, product.service.ts, product.service.spec.ts. catalogue.module.ts (pre-existing UNTRACKED) registers BulkSheetService and is NOT committed (listed in the commit body). ENDPOINT CONTRACT FOR FEAT-004 (both on AdminCatalogueController, class-level @Roles('catalogue_manager'), prefix /admin; web calls via adminFetch): (1) GET /admin/products/sheet -> SheetExport = { rows: SheetExportRow[]; categories: SheetCategoryOption[] } (types from @belzo/shared). rows: draft+published products ordered createdAt desc; per product a Parent row (indicator 'Parent', parentSku null, sku = saved or derived Parent SKU, product fields, images 1-5 = first 5 of de-duplicated gallery) then one Child row per active variant (indicator 'Child', parentSku set, repeats finalDetail/brand/description/hsnCode/taxType 'Inclusive'/gstRate), or ONE Parent row carrying variant fields in single-row form (exactly one active variant whose sku === parentSku). Money = rupees (number), weightKg = kg number or null when 0, stock/packOf integers, tier1..5 = full-precision percent numbers (e.g. 22 or 18.0018) or null, gstRate text like '12%' (also non-standard '3%'), null = blank cell. Empty catalogue -> rows: [] (the client adds the EXAMPLE rows). categories: active leaf categories (no active children), { label (name if it resolves back to that category, else slug), slug, path: ancestor names joined ' › ' }, sorted by path. (2) POST /admin/products/bulk-v2 body { rows: SheetRowInput[] (1..1000; each { row: int 2..1_000_000, ...optional string cells keyed by SheetKey, each z.string().max(SHEET_FIELD_MAX[key]) — so Child title/description must be dropped by slimChildRow or a >200/5000 value is a 400) }, weightUnit?: 'g' | 'kg' (pass mapHeaderRow().weightUnitHint when not null; 'g' turns parsed weights > 50 kg into the row error `Weight is in kg — <raw> looks like grams; enter <raw/1000> (e.g. 0.2)`) } -> SheetImportResult = { productsCreated, productsUpdated, variantsCreated, variantsUpdated, issues: SheetIssue[] { row, sku, level: 'error'|'warning', message } }. Unknown body keys are stripped by zod; structural violations are a request-level 400; all content problems are per-row issues. The server re-runs groupSheetRows per request (so grouping warnings such as the case hint/EXAMPLE skip may duplicate client ones -> de-dup by `${row}|${level}|${message}`), processes groups sequentially, each in its own $transaction (timeout 20 s). Counts: matched existing products/variants count as updated even with an empty diff. Plan warnings are only returned for groups that committed; a failed group gives `Not saved: <message>` on its Parent row + planned Child rows. GET /admin/products/export, ProductService.exportRows, toExportRows and ProductExportRow are REMOVED (export-button.tsx must go in FEAT-004). POST /admin/products/bulk kept, JSDoc @deprecated. ProductService.uniqueSlug / findOrCreateBrandByName are now public. Implementation notes: mergeAttr uses an exported REMOVE_ATTR symbol (not the string 'remove', so a Size cell 'remove' stays a value); in single-row form a variant-row error fails the whole group (the Parent row is the variant); planner ctx.product carries activeVariantCount (target load adds _count of active variants).
